description: A shell script for restoring various types of databases (SQLite, PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB) from backup files, with automatic detection of backup type and database availability.

methods.name: pg_isready
methods.description: Checks if PostgreSQL server is ready to accept connections.

methods.name: psql
methods.description: PostgreSQL command-line client used to execute SQL commands.

methods.name: mysqladmin
methods.description: Utility to perform administrative operations on MySQL server.

methods.name: mysql
methods.description: MySQL command-line client used to execute SQL commands.

methods.name: mongosh
methods.description: MongoDB shell used to run commands and check server status.

methods.name: mongorestore
methods.description: Utility to restore MongoDB databases from archive files.
